_comment: NOT-MUSIC GATE. Málaga Live is a LIVE MUSIC site, but several venues we track publish their WHOLE programme — Auditorio Municipal de Benalmádena (operabenalmadena / tickets.oneboxtds.com) and Marenostrum Castle Park (marenostrumfuengirola.com) list theatre, dance, comedy, magic and children's shows next to the concerts, and the weekly LLM sweep takes the lot. Deleting such a row from the calendar does NOT hold: the next sweep re-adds it from the same venue page. So exclusions live here and are applied by build_site.py on EVERY build, as a gate running BEFORE the phantom / Fever-unbuyable / receipt gates. Matching is on the normalised act name (lowercase, accents stripped) and is a SUBSTRING test. IMPORTANT: set 'venue' whenever the phrase could belong to a real act somewhere else — a personal name ('David Navarro', 'José Tejada') or a common phrase ('La Granja') must be scoped to the venue, or a genuine gig elsewhere would be silently dropped. Omit 'venue' only for names distinctive enough to be safe anywhere. NOT blocked, deliberately: CABARET 2.0 at the same Benalmádena venue IS live music (Sofia 2026-07-29). This gate's drops appear in the build log's [gate] block. NOTE (2026-08-04): this file is now shipped by the canonical deploy-site.bat (added to its Website scp list), so a normal deploy applies any edit here — no separate genre-fix bat needed. This gate also carries OWNER CONTENT-POLICY removals (e.g. 'love of lesbian', DLR 2026-08-04), not only not-music rows; the log prefix 'not live music' is cosmetic for those. STANDING INSTRUCTION (Sofia, 2026-08-24): do NOT wait for a non-music show to appear on the site or in a reel before acting. Whenever comedy, theatre, a clown/children's show, magic, dance or any other non-music event is spotted on a tracked venue's programme, TELL SOFIA IMMEDIATELY so it can be added here in advance - she cannot know about shows she has never seen. Pre-loading beats reacting: a reactive block only helps after the thing has already been published.

The site was showing this show TWICE: 22 Aug (as 'I Noche Flamenca del Compás', onebox select/2697427) and 23 Aug (as 'NOCHE FLAMENCA DEL COMPÁS', onebox events/51613). Browser-confirmed 08-17 on the seller's own SESIONES tab: event 51613 has exactly ONE session, SÁB 22 AGO 22:00, €30, 'Disponibilidad media'. There is no 23 Aug show — the venue's blurb reads 'Del 22 al 23 de agosto' (a festival window) and that range was read as a second night. The 08-15 re-date fixed the map entry but the stale calendar row survived. THE DATE SCOPE IS THE WHOLE POINT: an act-only block would also have deleted the REAL, on-sale 22 Aug gig. Keep the 22 Aug card; this removes only the phantom 23 Aug one.

Keeps the Dia 1/2/3 series, which names the right venue and the bill. THE VENUE SCOPE IS THE WHOLE POINT: the gate is a SUBSTRING test, so 'canela party 2026' also appears inside 'Canela Party 2026 - Dia 1 (Unknown Mortal Orchestra...)'; only the venue clause keeps Dia 1 alive. If a future build ever labels the Dia 1 row 'Plaza de Toros', this entry would remove it too - re-check if Dia 1 disappears from 27 Aug. REVERSIBLE: delete to show both cards again.
